description: ITL workflow defects fixed in this version. A recurrence of a listed code is a new defect. Open defects and their workarounds live in organization memory notes titled 'Дефект ITL <CODE>: ...' (workflow-incidents.md); memory_status names such notes once their code is listed here, and update-workflow names unclosed handoff reports for these keys. Maintained by ITL source developers: a fix adds its entry in the same commit.

entries.symptom: After a failed on-demand MCP start the client and the per-infobase guard keep holding the infobase; the helper waits in waiting-for-base.
After a lost backend connection or an infobase reload the facade lease keeps holding the infobase; cleanup refuses with LAUNCH_PROOF_REQUIRED or RECOVERY_LEASE_CHANGED and check-dev-branch fails.
After a successful execute_code the ROCTUP client keeps the infobase and check-dev-branch stalls in Designer until DESIGNER_STALL_TIMEOUT.
Right after TestClient shutdown its port still counts as busy (TIME_WAIT, ESTABLISHED or CLOSE_WAIT) and the next start fails.
A Vanessa code step executed through the clipboard extension swallows the exception and reports success.
entries.regression: OneScript probes and the native build in develop 1e99c70c

entries.symptom: After refresh or update-workflow a facade process started earlier by the client keeps running the old version; ITL does not detect it.
entries.fixedIn: develop 44c22f61 (facade 0.4.34) + 1df7efe5, b547871b, a21fc5f0 (relay itl-ondemand-relay-v1.0.0, facade 0.4.37); the first switch to the relay needs one client restart

entries.symptom: execute_feature_step reports success for a step that raises an exception.
While the Windows session is locked a UI step cannot find the VAExtension form and the run is classified as product-assertion.
A hidden TestClient form takes the foreground during a run; user keystrokes reach the 1C client.

codes: chore: reset branch for next change
entries.symptom: A branch reset creates a single-parent commit, so the next refresh merges against an old merge base and reports false conflicts.
check-dev-branch is killed by the runner watchdog after tests pass, while assessment and the user report run without a heartbeat.
A failed execute_form_actions, a modal window or get_form_element_data for a missing element ends TestClient; the next call starts a fresh client.
entries.fixedIn: develop d7bb8a7c (facade 0.4.36); a real TestClient process crash stays a separate incident

entries.symptom: A stateful Vanessa UI call runs on a replaced, empty TestClient without a warning; input steps report success.

codes: значение не является значением объектного типа
entries.symptom: A run_scenario result whose failed step or product text contains a generic platform phrase is replaced by a runtime/editor failure.
One fixed Vanessa budget covers the whole selected TESTMANAGER run; long suites end by timeout without test failures.
The Vanessa service TESTMANAGER infobase sometimes fails to start with an invalid configuration signature; no automatic retry exists.
entries.fixedIn: develop 55330bf6 (a launch refused by the signature check is repeated once automatically; the root cause is not established)

entries.symptom: In the hidden window mode a Vanessa or MCP dropdown selection lost the foreground to another window while the user worked; 1C closed the list and the step failed once without a repeat.
entries.fixedIn: develop 24060c9f + 9321b90d (Vanessa itl-r19: the selection is read back and repeated up to two times after a pause in user input; the final failure names -DropdownPrompt)

entries.symptom: After a refresh merged a large master delta, the Vanessa preflight of check-dev-branch selected scenarios for over two minutes at stage start without a heartbeat; the runner watchdog stopped the check before the load.
entries.fixedIn: develop 0f4af59a (the preflight runs at stage vanessa.preflight under the run-status heartbeat)
